name: Pieces of Mind
source:
Pieces of Mind is a visual novel where you play as a small-town WWI-era psychologist whose patients may or may not be killing each other.

Are their secrets safe with you?
How many lives are they worth?

[From [url=https://promo.piecesofmind.co]the official website[/url]]
